import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import os,subprocess,json,resource,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
p=json.loads(Path('PINS.json').read_text());assert hashlib.sha256(Path(p['lean_bin']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==p['lean_sha256'];resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_STACK,(512*1024,512*1024));env=dict(os.environ,LEAN_PATH=os.pathsep.join([str(Path.cwd()/'build')]+p['upstream_lean_paths']),LEAN_NUM_THREADS='1')
r=subprocess.run([p['lean_bin'],'-j1','-s8192','-M3500','-DwarningAsError=true','audit/OwnDeclarations.lean'],env=env,text=True,capture_output=True);print(r.stdout);print(r.stderr);raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
